result.summary: This pull request hardens legacy BDB to descriptor SQLite wallet migration against unexpected errors and filesystem failures. It catches exceptions during migration steps so the wallet can restore the original database from backup, gracefully handles non-writable database directories, and refactors MigrateToSQLite to build the new SQLite database in a temporary path before removing the original database files.
result.problem: During legacy wallet migration, uncaught exceptions or write errors can crash the node or GUI, skip cleanup, and leave the database in a half-converted state requiring manual file restoration from backups.

resolved_concerns: Benchmark CI failure on Windows msvcrt due to temporary file collision was resolved (maflcko, hebasto)

categories.rationale: Migration correctness and recovery safety are major priorities in the wallet category for users transitioning from legacy BDB wallets. By delaying the deletion of the legacy database until the new SQLite database has been constructed and catching unexpected exceptions during migration, this PR prevents corrupt or interrupted migrations from stranding users without an automated recovery path.

result.card: This PR improves legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration by ensuring failures do not leave the wallet in a corrupted state or crash the application. It creates the SQLite database in a temporary path before touching the original BDB files and catches internal exceptions to enable clean automatic rollback from backup. The change directly protects users during the mandatory migration path away from BerkeleyDB. The PR has a code-review ACK from ryanofsky with recent review suggestions applied, but it is currently marked dirty and needs a rebase.
